tasks.title: The motor frequency from eRPM
tasks.statement: The ESC reports **{e} eRPM**, `motor_poles = {p}`. Find the frequency of the motor fundamental (Hz).
tasks.solution: RPM = eRPM / (poles/2), f = RPM/60. A wrong `motor_poles` shifts all the notches: with 12 instead of 14 the filter will sit at 7/6 of the real frequency.

tasks.title: The third harmonic versus the lower limit
tasks.statement: A motor in hover — **{rpm} RPM**. Find the frequency of the third harmonic (Hz).
tasks.solution: The k-th harmonic is k·RPM/60. If the fundamental is below `rpm_filter_min_hz`, its notch sits at the limit, beside the noise; the harmonics above it are filtered.
